$schema_note: Default race intensity (IF = normalized power / FTP at race altitude) for the race finish-time planner, by rider level and predicted riding hours. Locked by Matt on 2026-11-11. Design and sources: bbs-race-dataset research/IF_DEFAULTS.md sections 5-6. Change only with a dated amendment there.
form: IF = a - b * ln(hours), hours = predicted riding hours (iterate until stable)
anchors: Elite: public Unbound 200 winner files IF 0.70 and 0.76 (9-10 h); pro road monuments IF 0.77 at 6.8 h (van Erp & Sanders 2021); pro women IF 0.83 at 3.2 h (Sanders 2019)
Advanced and Intermediate: amateur 6-9 h race IF 0.59-0.75 (Faulkner 2025; Barranco-Gil 2024; Reinpold 2021)
Intermediate check: coach estimate IF 0.80 as a 2-3 h maximum
Beginner: coach estimate of a sharp drop after about 90 min; floor at the low end of the classic endurance band (0.56)
carb_term_reason: No trial quantifies a carb-dependent shift in multi-hour average power or IF; carbs act through the planner's gut-training row (research/CARB_INTAKE_EVIDENCE.md).
